visual_action: The video displays a sequence of three static images. First, a close-up photo of the right side of Donald Trump's smiling face against an American flag. Second, a close-up photo of the left side of Joe Biden's smiling face against a grey background. Third, a screenshot of a tweet from the social media account for 'The Democrats'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: A photo of Donald Trump is shown with the overlay text 'the worst jobs president since the Great Depression'.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: A photo of Joe Biden is shown with the overlay text 'and the president with historic job growth'. A subsequent tweet also names him '@JoeBiden'.

cast.name: The Democrats
cast.evidence: A screenshot of a tweet from the account 'The Democrats' (@TheDemocrats) is shown at the end of the video.

intended_effect: To persuade viewers of Joe Biden's economic success and Donald Trump's economic failure regarding job creation.
